name: uix-monorepo
description: UIx v2 — private workspace root. Publishable packages live in packages/* (@tensor_1/tokens, @tensor_1/react). Source of the --uix-* contract (ADR-0016).

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:react
scripts.test:api: api-extractor run --config packages/react/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --config packages/react/api-extractor.chart.json
scripts.test:api:update: api-extractor run --local --config packages/react/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local --config packages/react/api-extractor.chart.json

//react: React 18.3.1 is a ROOT devDep (not used by the root itself) so the A11Y-3 jest-axe harness resolves a SINGLE React across the workspace: it satisfies @testing-library/react's ^18||^19 peer, so npm does not also pull React 19. NOTE: an `overrides` block was removed here — it made npm-install's lockfile fail npm-ci's own sync check (EUSAGE); the direct devDep alone pins React 18.
